title: Partial sale in pre-split units, then a 10->2 split re-denominates only the remaining open lot
rules: Sub-division of shares (Companies Act 2013 s.61(1)(d)): no new asset; cost spread over new shares, holding period from original purchase (settled practice - see INDEX.md)
Income-tax Act 1961 s.2(42A) first proviso; s.112A(1) as amended by Finance (No.2) Act 2024: 12.5 % above Rs 1,25,000 for transfers on/after 23-Jul-2024
derivation: Sale 2024-08-20 (before the split): 40 @ 1,300.00 -> proceeds 52,000.00; cost 40 x 1,000 = 40,000.00; gain 12,000.00. Quantity stays 40 (pre-split units).
Split 2025-01-15 face value 10 -> 2 (x5): remaining 60 -> 300 shares; cost per share 1,000 / 5 = 200.00; acquired date unchanged 2023-02-01.
